config.owner_request: 2026-11-08: owner approved 'Run a stricter control against similar sharp drops that had no breadth signal?' (Yes, run it) after the 13-case 50-99 zero-follower six-day review.
config.question: Does the breadth signal (one native 5m bar with 50-99 coins first-touching the weekly lower 1.618, then zero new lower touches for 30 minutes) add six-day return beyond a similar sharp drop of the same coin without a breadth crash?
config.single_variable: Presence of the breadth signal at entry. Entry rule, six-day fixed exit, costs and price series are identical in both arms.
config.price_series: yoyo.evaluation.monday_breadth_excursion_prices.prices (Binance USD-M 5m, same as the six-day study)
config.returns: yoyo.evaluation.monday_breadth_reversal_window.trade_returns (VectorBT from_orders, buy at decision 5m open, sell at the open 1728 bars later, taker 0.05% on both fills, unlevered, no funding or slippage), run once for events and controls

features_at_entry_open_T.drop24: min of the 12 closes before T divided by max of the 288 closes before T, minus 1
features_at_entry_open_T.bounce1h: open at T divided by min of the 12 closes before T, minus 1
features_at_entry_open_T.trend30: close before T divided by the close 8640 bars earlier, minus 1
features_at_entry_open_T.vol7: std of 5m log close changes over the 2016 bars before T

control_pool.distance: Euclidean on the four features standardized by the pool standard deviation; greedy nearest with 24h minimum spacing

config.sensitivity: Conservative pool that also drops controls with any >=25-coin lower bar inside their own six-day holding window (uses future information to exclude, so it can only make controls look better).
config.decision_rule: Per asset on the primary 13 events: the breadth signal adds value beyond the drop if the mean paired excess (event net minus the mean net of its matched controls) is positive and its event-bootstrap 95% CI (20000 draws, seed 20261108) excludes zero. Three assets are tested; report all, adopt nothing automatically.
config.in_sample_note: The 50-99 zero-follower cell was chosen after seeing results; this control tests a mechanism, not a blind period.
